Week under way: sims count real points; same-name injury fix; brief engine split

- sim.py / championship.py: once a week's games start, each team's score = real
  points so far (Yahoo API scoreboard) + each man's share still to play (nflverse
  schedule); Dom's game uses the meter's Yahoo projected finals. Monday's brief had
  DK II 52% / DK IV 53% to win while Yahoo had both at 0%.
- engine3v.py + pull_feeds.py: ESPN injury feed limited to fantasy positions - the
  Browns LB Justin Jefferson (inactive Sun) zeroed the Vikings' Jefferson in Gotham.
- brief_ratcliffe.py: "Ratcliffe vs engine" splits skip men whose game has started
  (the engine number is then his real score, not a projection).
